# WDC Kyoto one-minute AE/AL indices

The two vendored CSVs contain the public one-minute AE and AL inputs used by
the offline analysis.

- Source: https://wdc.kugi.kyoto-u.ac.jp/
- Retrieved: 2026-08-09
- Coverage: 2024-05-06 through 2024-05-19 and 2024-10-05 through
  2024-10-18, inclusive

The fetcher prefers provisional data and falls back to QUICKLK real-time
data when provisional files are unavailable. The CSVs may therefore mix
the two classes, and a future fetch may yield revised values. These
vendored copies are the fixed inputs used for the manuscript reproduction.
